City & Us privacy

Testing build · 29 October 2026

This build is a solo game. It does not send your story, name, local Player ID or settings to a game server. It includes no account sign-in, analytics, advertising, purchases, live chat or microphone recording.

Your chosen character name, random local Player ID, appearance, gameplay progress, inventory and settings are stored on your device. They remain until you replace the story, clear app/browser storage or uninstall. Export saves before uninstalling or moving to another device.

Save import and export happen only when you choose them in Settings. On Android, the system document picker lets you choose a destination; if you choose a cloud document provider, that provider handles the file under its own policies. Keep exports private if you do not want others to see your chosen name and game progress.

Dialogue uses bundled synthetic recordings and has volume, mute, subtitles and text-only controls. The game does not record your voice. Android assets work offline with no app internet permission. Browser reviews are served by the host you open, which may log ordinary web requests; this statement does not describe a future online release.

Diagnostics stay on the device unless you deliberately copy/share them. They include startup, graphics and device/browser information, not save contents.

To delete a local story use Settings → Start a new story. To remove all local identifiers and stored data, clear this app's storage or this site's browser data. Files you exported must be deleted separately.

Release status: owner contact details and a public policy URL must be supplied before store submission. This is a factual testing-build policy draft, not a published store policy.
